title: Fenn is imprisoned on a charge his own dialogue (and the pardon he sends you to find) proves false, but no dialogue or action anywhere lets you free him, tell a guard, or return to him with the news. The whole thread resolves through the Gallows Glade ritual and Fenn's own captivity is never revisited.
